name: Collision Course
blurb: Fight the Scorched to claim a Cargobot supply drop.

stages.log_text: We received an automated emergency transmission about a Cargobot on its way to make a supply drop at Morgantown Airport. If we don't clear the landing zone of hostiles, the Cargobot will abort the supply drop.

We received an automated emergency transmission about a Vertibot on its way to make a supply drop at Morgantown Airport. We had to fight off a horde of Scorched, but were were finally able to secure the landing zone. Now we're waiting for the Vertibot to make its delivery.

We received an automated emergency transmission about a cargobot on its way to make a supply drop at Morgantown Airport. We had to fight off a horde of Scorched, but we were finally able to secure the landing zone so the cargobot could successfully complete its mission.

We received an automated emergency transmission about a cargobot on its way to make a supply drop at Morgantown Airport. A horde of Scorched swarmed the area and we failed to secure the landing zone in time. As a result, the cargobot abandoned the supply drop.
